characters.description: A former costume that has been transformed into an edible monster by the Evil Masked Figure, presumably the sixth monster to be brought to life. All There in the Manual: A featurette reveals that a man named Timmy is the original identity of the Cotton Candy Glob, and he explains his backstory during it, including why he wore the costume and how he was defeated. Anthropomorphic Food: Just as his name suggests, he's a living glob of cotton candy. Big "NO!": He yelled it once Shaggy and Scooby start eating him. Canon Foreigner: He was created for the movie and never appeared in any of the original Hanna-Barbera cartoons.

characters.name: Principal Deedle / The Specter
characters.description: The principal of Coolsville High School, who is secretly plotting to use ghosts to find a time capsule. The Alleged Boss: He was the principal, but he was overruled so many times by Grimes that his rank seems to be for decoration. Big Bad: He is the main villain ofThe Mystery Begins. "Scooby-Doo" Hoax: Played with. He was another criminal disguised as a supernatural being, but his plan was aided by a pair of real ghosts named Ezekiel Gallows and Prudence Prufrock. Small Role, Big Impact: By pushing Shaggy to find some friends results in him meeting Daphne, Fred, and Velma who not only solve the mystery at the school, but form a strong bond and go on to form Mystery, Inc.

characters.name: Ezekiel Gallows and Prudence Prufrock
characters.description: The ghosts of two deceased teachers of Coolsville High who were raised from the dead to aid the Specter's plan. Alliterative Name: Prudence Prufrock's given name and surname both begin with P. Anti-Villain: Neither of them are actually evil spirits, as they're simply controlled by the actual villain to do his dirty job. Once the Gang frees them and sends them back to their graves, they're apologetic and inform them that "(Principal Deedle) was controlling (them)". Co-Dragons: They're both subservient to the Specter. Ghastly Ghost: They're sickly green ghosts forced to haunt the school and be part of Deedle's scheme.

characters.name: Vice Principal Grimes
characters.description: The ill-tempered Vice Principal of Coolsville High School, who runs the place with an iron fist. Break the Haughty: For the better part of the movie, he's an irascibleDean Bittermanwho's sorely convinced that the Gang are to blame for everything bad happening at the school, Then he's captured by the real culprit, and, after being freed, he's forced to admit that he misjudged the Gang and sincerely apologizes to them. Butt-Monkey: His brand new car is damaged twice, his beloved school is haunted and vandalized, and, finally, he's kidnapped by the villains and locked inside a dog cage. Dean Bitterman: He's very strict, refuses to listen to the Gang's explanations and gives them increasingly worse punishments. Foil: To Principal Deedle. While Deedle seems very friendly and without a mean bone in his body but barely exerts discipline as a principal, Grimes is irritable, strict, and often takes over to exert discipline over the students. Deedle turns out be the villain, who doesn't care about closing and even destroying the school to get his hands on his precious rare stamp, whilst Grimes, for all of hisDean Bittermantendencies, cares deeply about his school and while apologizing to the Gang for unfairly blaming them, he admits that part of his efforts were to keep the school he cared for so much open.

characters.name: Wanda Grubwort
characters.description: An evil witch who was burned at the stake in the past for terrorizing people with frog monsters. Big Bad: She is the main villain ofCurse of the Lake Monster. Grand Theft Me: She carries out her plan by possessing Velma. Wicked Witch: She's an evil witch.

characters.name: Holly Graham/Mastermind
characters.description: The cousin of Daphne who uses holograms. Big Bad: The Mastermind is the main villain, having brought back past foes of Mystery, Inc. to try and defeat our heroes. Big Bad Friend: It turns out that Daphne's cousin Holly Graham is theactualmastermind of the operation, who used her know-how of Mystery Inc.'s previous cases to orchestrate everything. Chekhov's Gunman: Holly, Daphne's cousin who Scooby rescues early in the game and then vanishes afterwards, turns out to be the main villain. Final Boss: The game ends with a final boss fight against the Mastermind.

characters.name: Groundskeeper
characters.description: The Groundskeeper shown in the game. The Butler Did It: Shaggy initially suspects him as the culprit. Much to his frustration, the groundskeeper comes out to complain how the groundskeepers are prime suspect for every mysteries. Breaking the Fourth Wall: In idle dialogue, the Groundskeeper wonders why there are so many Scooby Snacks around. Ink-Suit Actor: He looks like his voice actor. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He insults and snarks at Scooby a few times throughout the game, but gives him advice on how to proceed and even helps him out by providing him with some upgrades.

characters.name: Alan Dinsdale
characters.description: The head of Hambridge University Library. No Celebrities Were Harmed: He bares more than a slight resemblance toMorgan Freeman, to the point whereJeff Bennettis clearly doing a vocal impersonation.

characters.name: Travis Sherman
characters.description: The head ofShermanTech. Big Bad: He uses the Tome of Doom to acquire more land and an alpha wave modulator to brainwash people into buying his products. However, he turns out to bea figureheadfor Selena Drake, his employee who uses the Tome of Doom to assist in her plan to mind-control the world. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Aside from using the Tome of Doom to assist in land acquisition by scaring people away with the monsters to force the owners to sell, he also intends to use Selena Drake's alpha wave modulator to brainwash everyone into buying only the products his company makes. Disc-One Final Boss: He does appear to be theBig Badin the game, only to end up being a figurehead to the realBig Badof the game, Selena Drake, his former dragon. Even Evil Has Standards: Heonlywanted to brainwash people into buying his products. When Selena takes over and reveals her plans to take over the world, he's just as shocked as everyone else and tries to order her to stand down.

characters.name: Selena Drake
characters.description: The executive chief officer ofShermanTech. Big Bad: She takes theBig Badmantle as soon as Travis is defeated and proved to be more dangerous than her former boss ever was. Dragon Ascendant: She is set up as an employee for Travis Sherman, the mainBig Badof the game, but she eventually takes over as the true villain in the final chapter. Mad Scientist: Her main goal to use the alpha wave modulator to control everyone's minds.

characters.name: Walter Peabody/The Ghost
characters.description: Alan Dinsdale's assistant at the Hambridge University Library. Starter Villain: He is the first villain encountered in the game.

characters.name: Maggie Xi/Zen Tuo
characters.description: Starter Villain: She is the first villain encountered in the game.

characters.name: Ho Fong
characters.description: Adaptational Heroism:A. Fong was operating as the ghost of Zen Tuo for his smuggling operation inScooby-Doo, Where Are You!. Here, where he is renamed Ho Fong, he remains a good egg from start to finish with nothing to do with the ghost of Zen Tuo. Adaptation Name Change: A. Fong fromScooby-Doo, Where Are You!gets renamed Ho Fong.
